The Gatekeeper boldly demonstrates that combining contrasting styles in a single timepiece creates a striking, standout statement. SHIPPED FROM NEW YORK, USA

watches.name: Scylla Green
watches.description: Decima Scylla is inspired by ancient Roman-Greek water “monster” of the same name. Scylla is a beautiful women stuck forever in between 12 monsters attached to her belly, that kill anyone in her field of vision. Each edge of the bezel symbolizes the monsters attached to her belly and the dial symbolizes the beautiful women stuck in between them.

specsRaw.Dial: Two Tone Gradient Sunburst with Aplied Hour Indices
